employment.title: Platform Engineer
employment.summary: Built and operated internal platform services for Kubernetes-based workloads; improved rollout automation and time-to-deploy. Developed Terraform IaC modules, implemented CI/CD pipelines, established observability standards (Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry), enforced least-privilege IAM and Vault-based secret management, and automated environment management via GitOps (Argo CD) with policy-as-code checks (OPA/Gatekeeper).

employment.title: Platform Engineer
employment.summary: Supported enterprise CI/CD for microservices/data platforms; delivered blue/green deployments. Created reusable Kubernetes Helm charts/templates, implemented Terraform/Ansible/AWS CloudFormation for configuration management, enhanced observability (ELK/OpenSearch, SLI/SLO dashboards), performed incident response/root-cause/postmortems, and collaborated to harden connectivity and access controls.

employment.title: Software Engineer (Infrastructure)
employment.summary: Contributed to automated build/deployment tooling. Built Python/Bash scripts to streamline operational tasks (log collection, health checks, deployment validation), helped containerize applications with Docker, and supported monitoring/alerting improvements for service health and capacity thresholds.
